The Cathode Ray Tube is a complex device that needs a bit of setup to work
First, you need to provide 12 volts between the Heater and Cathode pins
Next, connect about 1000 volts between the Anode and Cathode
You can change the position of the dot using the deflection coils
You can apply a negative voltage to the Grid to change brightness of the trace

pon.h: Monitoring Electricity using the Current Gauge
t: The Current Gauge displays the current flowing through it's terminals
Current gauges are in series with the circuit so they can have an effect on the transferred power
Some devices don't directly expose their electrical terminals
To power them, you'll have to place a Device Connector and attach your wires to it
The Device Connector can also be used to power Forge Energy and Create: The Factory Must Grow devices (if installed)
The Electric Fan Moves Air Using Electricity
Direction and Speed Are Dependent on the Voltage Applied
Fans Can Blow Air Over Hot Components to Cool Them Down
The electric motor lets you convert electricity into rotation
The speed of the motor depends on the voltage you provide

tip.s: Pushes back and stuns enemies (if they aren't too strong) when powered with Forge Energy from a Portable Battery
p: Attacked enemies will be stunned and no durability will be used. Instead, Forge Energy is drained from the Battery

t: The Electromagnet can process items provided beneath it
The Input items can be dropped or placed on a Depot under the Electromagnet
When items are provided on a belt...
The Electromagnet will hold and process them automatically

tip.s: Fires a lightning bolt that bounces off of nearby enemies, splitting the damage between them. Can be powered with Forge Energy from a Portable Battery
p: No durability will be used. Instead, Forge Energy is drained from the Battery

t: The Generator Clutch is the base of all generator assemblies
It provides a weak coupling between your kinetic network and the generator shaft
You can use a redstone signal to change the coupling strength
The generator housing can be used to connect windings around a rotor
This allows for a cleaner generator setup with less wires connected around rotors
The growth lamp is a special type of light bulb which accelerates crop growth in a certain area when powered on
The heating coil can be used to heat up the passing Air Flow if enough power is applied to it
By applying a bigger voltage the Air Flow can be used for bulk blasting
The heating coil allows for faster bulk processing
HV Breaker can be used to safely switch a high power load
To close it, you must first wind it up
Its state can then be toggled with a redstone pulse
The breaker can be opened without having to wind it up again

pon.h: Setting up a High Voltage Switch
t: High Voltage Switches can be used to connect or disconnect high voltage circuits
To create one, place a Connector in the direction of the High Voltage Switch
Leave a one-block gap between them
The High Voltage Switch can be operated manually...
...or with the help of Redstone
The High Voltage Switch allows you to toggle electricity using a kinetic input

tip.s: Use Mechanical Arms to insert used components and complete the circuit
A multi-purpose tool, handful to anyone who wants to play with electricity
p: Can be used to probe voltage between terminals and current flowing through wires

t: The Plotter is a simple electromechanical device that measures voltage over time
The graph color can be changed by right clicking the plotter with a dye

tip.s: A Wearable Battery for carrying energy
p: Provides Forge Energy to Equipment that requires it
Stores energy at a rate depending on the Supplied Voltage

tip.s: An all natural source of green energy

pon.h: Monitoring Electricity using the Power Gauge
t: The Power Gauge can be used to measure power going into a section of the electrical network
The Power Resistor is a simple device which lets you limit the current flow in a circuit.
You can change the resistance by clicking on its top
The current flow is equal to the voltage across the resistor divided by its resistance (I = V / R)
The Punch Card Reader is a device that can be used to playback a sequence of signals.
It will connect the common terminal to an output pin when a hole is read from the card.
To work, the device needs a kinetic input. Rotation speed controls the read speed.
Punch Cards can be inserted manually or automatically.
A rheostat can be used to vary electrical resistance using a kinetic input
A Servo can be used to precisely control mechanical movements using an electric signal
The control pin accepts a voltage between -5 and 5 volts, which maps to -360 and 360 degrees of rotation

tip.s: A simple device which measures the temperature of things
p: Measures the temperature of the device it is pointed at
Measures current and maximum temperature of the device it is placed on over time

t: A variac can be used to variably transform voltages using a kinetic input

pon.h: Monitoring Electricity using the Voltage Gauge
t: The Voltage Gauge displays the voltage potential between it's terminals
Wires are used to transfer electricity between terminals of electric devices
Every wire has a resistance, the longer the wire, the more resistance it has
This causes a voltage drop to occur when current is flowing
Lost power is turned into heat
If too much power is drawn, the wires can overheat and break
Wire connectors can be used as attachment points for wires

tip.s: A tool used to remove wires
p: Removes a hanging wire, or selected segment of a block wire
When Shift R-Clicked on a block wire

pon.h: Using a compressor to process fluids
t: The Compressor can process fluids into items
It can be powered with a shaft from the side
It must move clockwise from the right side
Fluids can be inserted from the back
Minimum heat must be provided
Lastly, the output can be retrieved with a depot, belt or basin

tip.s: Plunge fluids out of any block
p: Plunges the first fluid contained in the Block
When used on a Block containing Fluid

pon.h: Using a sapper to gather resources
t: Sappers are machines used to sap fluids from trees
You can power them with cogs
And then pull the output fluids from the back
Right-click it with a valid tool
The slicer can also operate on a basin

tip.s: Trade with Villagers, note that villagers will only trade during normal working times of day.

t: To complete trades with multiple inputs, 2 depots can be used together
While not required, you should set the filter on the first input to avoid other trades
Note that trading depots will only share contents if they have matching filters, or the other is empty
The output then goes to whichever depot has the first item of the trade
To use a trading depot, attach it to a villager workstation
When a villager next works at their workstation they will trade with the attached depot
